title: External MLL23 evaluation
label: tab:exp40-external-mll23
caption: External MLL23 ten-class results. Values are reported mean ± sample standard deviation over seeds 17, 29, and 43. N/A denotes an unsupported method-output contract, not zero. Best and second-best available results in each metric column are bolded and underlined, respectively; ties share the same marker. The proposed method is shaded. This is bounded external class/path evidence and does not test MLL23 attribute correctness.
